title: Continuous Improvement Manager
description:
**Continuous Improvement Manager, Arakkonam**
*Where Growth Never Stops*
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*
*When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens*
.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fuller Technologies is seeking a hands-on Continuous Improvement Manager to help build and embed our operating system across global manufacturing, sourcing, and procurement. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will lead practical improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, working capital, and productivity.
  
  
You’ll work closely with teams from the shop floor through supply chain and senior leadership to map value streams, remove barriers, standardize effective ways of working, and deliver measurable results. This is an opportunity for an operational leader who enjoys turning complex processes into clear, sustainable improvements—and helping teams build the discipline to maintain them.
  
  
The location of the position will be based out of our Manufacturing facility in India in Arakkonam
  
  
**Your Responsibilities :**
**Value Stream Development**

* Support the COO and operations leadership team in standing up and maturing value streams across manufacturing, sourcing, procurement, and supply chain.
* Lead value stream mapping to understand current-state processes, identify waste, constraints, handoffs, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop future-state value stream designs and actionable improvement roadmaps.
* Establish clear ownership, KPIs, operating rhythms, and accountability within each value stream.
* Help connect procurement, suppliers, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and customer requirements into an integrated end-to-end operating model.
* Facilitate cross-functional value stream reviews and ensure actions remain on track.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean and continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, lead time, inventory, and working capital.
* Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on business impact.
* Facilitate Kaizen events, problem-solving sessions, root-cause analysis, process mapping, and improvement workshops.
* Apply Lean methodologies including standard work, visual management, 5S, daily management, problem solving, flow, pull, and waste elimination.
* Build sustainable processes rather than one-time improvements by establishing standards, ownership, measurement, and follow-through.
* Partner with teams to simplify processes and eliminate unnecessary complexity.

**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence**

* Work directly with plant and operations leaders to improve manufacturing flow, productivity, throughput, capacity utilization, and schedule attainment.
* Support development of standard work and consistent operating practices across manufacturing locations.
* Identify bottlenecks and capacity constraints and develop improvement plans.
* Support improvements in material flow, inventory management, production planning, and shop-floor execution.
* Partner closely with HSEQ and operational leadership to ensure improvements reinforce safe and high-quality operations.

**Sourcing & Procurement Improvement**

* Partner with procurement and sourcing leadership to improve supplier, sourcing, and purchasing processes.
* Evaluate end-to-end procurement workflows, including demand identification, sourcing, purchase orders, supplier performance, material availability, and inventory.
* Help improve supplier lead times, delivery performance, responsiveness, cost, and quality.
* Identify opportunities to simplify purchasing processes, improve visibility, reduce cycle times, and strengthen accountability.
* Support supplier segmentation, performance management, and development initiatives where appropriate.
* Help connect sourcing and procurement priorities directly to manufacturing and value-stream requirements.

**Performance Management & Operating Rhythm**

* Establish practical KPIs and visual management tools that allow teams to quickly understand performance and take action.
* Support daily, weekly, and monthly operating reviews with clear metrics, actions, owners, and deadlines.
* Develop dashboards and reporting for key operational improvement initiatives.
* Track benefits and ensure improvement projects deliver measurable operational and financial results.
* Escalate barriers and risks requiring leadership support.
* Help create a culture where teams use data to identify problems, solve root causes, and continuously improve performance.

**Change Leadership & Capability Building**

* Coach leaders and employees in Lean thinking, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement practices.
* Build continuous improvement capability within the organization rather than creating dependency on the CI function.
* Facilitate cross-functional teams and influence change without relying solely on formal authority.
* Help establish common continuous improvement language, tools, and expectations across global operations.
* Recognize and share successful practices across locations and value streams.

**You bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, procurement, or continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean, operational excellence, or continuous improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong experience with value stream mapping and translating findings into practical improvement actions.
* Experience working across manufacturing and supply chain functions; sourcing or procurement experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable improvements in cost, productivity, lead time, quality, inventory, or delivery performance.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience facilitating Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred but not required; demonstrated application and results are more important than certification.
* Experience in an industrial, engineered-product, capital-equipment, or project-based manufacturing environment preferred.
* Comfortable working in a global, matrixed, and rapidly evolving organization.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Role:**
Production Manager

**Location:**
Hosur, Tamil Nadu

**Reporting to:**
Production Head - Vehicle

**Team Name:**
Manufacturing Operations

**About the Team and the Role**

The Manufacturing Operations team at Ather is responsible for orchestrating high-efficiency

electric vehicle manufacturing, driving production readiness from pilot phases to mass volume,

and delivering top-tier SQCDM benchmarks across factory operations.

This role is for a Production Manager who will lead end-to-end vehicle assembly line

operations, manage capital and operational expenditures, optimize shop floor resources, and

drive cross-functional engineering change management to meet organizational OKRs.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of contact for production programs, managing operational

timelines, CAPEX, and OPEX plans to ensure seamless line readiness and execution.

* Lead New Product Development (NPD/APQP) integration from proof-of-concept through

SOP, providing cross-functional technical inputs to CFT swimlanes.

* Deliver key operational metrics under SQCDM while coordinating with Shift-In-Charges (SICs) to deploy 3M (Man, Machine, Material) resources and maintain contingency planning.
* Oversee pre-SOP and post-SOP trial builds, executing structured root-cause analysis and implementing robust countermeasures for shop-floor concerns.
* Drive capacity utilization, line balancing, and productivity projects to consistently improve manufacturing efficiency and cost metrics.
* Direct engineering change management workflows (including MQ1, SOR, DAP, FTR, CR,and IA) in close collaboration with CFT stakeholders.
* Champion shop-floor safety and quality compliance by representing the production unit in internal and external IMS audits and closing all findings.
* Facilitate the design and integration of assembly tooling, fixtures, and lean manufacturing practices to enhance production ergonomics and throughput.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics &

Communication, or Mechatronics (MBA in Operations Management is an added advantage).

* 8 to 12 years of experience in Production, Process Engineering, or Operations Program

Management, preferably within the automobile industry.

**Must Have Competencies**

* High-volume vehicle assembly line management and mass production operations execution.
* Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), PFMEA development, and control plan deployment across the product development lifecycle.
* Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Toyota Production System (TPS), and Total Quality Management (TQM) implementation on the shop floor.
* 3M (Man, Machine, Material) resource optimization, line balancing, and operational capacity planning.

**Good to Have Competencies**

* Greenfield manufacturing project setup, line commissioning, and production ramp-up.
* Integrated Management Systems (IMS) compliance adhering to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 frameworks.
* Computer-aided factory layout planning and workflow design using AutoCAD and FactoryCAD.
* Enterprise resource planning and agile project execution using SAP and JIRA.

**Want to know more?**

At Ather, we’ve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of

clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We

are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching

more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex,

and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and

re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and

our Substack.

**Be You, With Us**

The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the

same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with

acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our

team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared

passion to shape the Ather journey.

title: Academic Programs & Innovation Manager
description:
In the role of the
 
**Program Manager, FORT.Academy** 

 the person shall report to the CEO, Forge and engage in a scope of work spanning techno\-managerial, financial, operational and administrative aspects relating to the broad
 
***Key Result Areas (KRAs)* 
 covering
 *program management \& operations of various offerings, Training services, Innovation Project Management services for MSMEs \& Startups, Partner/Client Stakeholder Management \& Ecosystem Connect, and General Administration.***





  






 FORT.Academy shall partner with various knowledge/capability partners, higher technical institutions and Industry partners (MSMEs and Startups) to implement the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum as an adjunct process to the academic curriculum, and as the consolidated process for all innovation centered initiatives, policies and programs at a national scale. The Program Manager is the operational lead for the MTP(Manufacturing Technology Practicum), requiring a high degree of organisational skill, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of the program's practical components. The role is a blend of administration, coordination, and participant\-facing support, ensuring that all program activities run smoothly and effectively.
 




  





**Introduction: FORT.Academy within Forge Innovation \& Ventures** 





 Forge Innovation \& Ventures operates as a vertically integrated enterprise, fundamentally committed to establishing and managing a national\-scale Open Innovation Value Network. The core objective of this network is to catalyse talent, technology, and ventures, thereby powering India's innovation economy in the Industrial Intelligence Age. The strategic framework of the organisation is meticulously structured around six Strategic Program Verticals (SPVs), each aligned with one of three core thrust areas: Talent, Technology, and Ventures.
 





 Forge.Academy is positioned as a core Strategic Program Vertical (SPV) under Forge's overarching "Talent" thrust area. Its primary function is to cultivate an innovation\-capable industrial workforce and entrepreneurial talent pool achieved through a comprehensive portfolio of university\-accredited/affiliated graduate education programs and professional development courses focused on innovation and entrepreneurship.
 




  






 FORT.Academy accelerates the convergence of industrial manufacturing with cutting\-edge technology, serving as the framework under which the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum for Industrial Workforce are implemented. Innovation Practicum for Technical Education is a unique program designed to redefine the role of an engineer by equipping students with a potent blend of technology, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit necessary to tackle contemporary industry challenges. Manufacturing Technology Practicum operationalises the Manufacturing Technology Practicum as the cornerstone of the Career Advancement \& Capability Development (CACD) program, providing a structured pathway for the industrial workforce to evolve from being passive technology users to becoming active innovators, strategists, and leaders.
 




  





**Position \& Designation** 




**Grade \- Manager or Sr. Manager** 





 The
 
**Program Manager** 

 to be designated in Forge at the grade of Manager or Sr.Manager shall be considered for a promotion to the role of Business Manager after having delivered a commendable performance in the stated role for a minimum tenure of 24 months.
 




  





**Compensation** 





 Forge compensation is at par with the top end of the social enterprises sector in India and continuously benchmarked to be above the average compensation offered in the social (non\-commercial or development) sector in general but significantly above the average compensation offered by TBIs. The Total CTC will include 3 major components namely,
 
**Fixed Monthly Gross** 

 ,
 
**Fixed Quarterly Payout, and Annual Development Bonus** 

 (linked to demonstration of progress on developing and strengthening capabilities in alignment with the Career Advancement and Capabilities Development framework of Forge).
 




  





**Role \& Responsibilities \- Key Result Areas** 



1. **Program Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of the MTP and all innovation programs, encompassing comprehensive logistical orchestration from inception to completion.
* Create and manage detailed course schedules while coordinating seamlessly with faculty, coaches, and external partners to guarantee timely availability of all facilities and resources.
* Ensure robust support for hands\-on lab sessions, practical exercises, and innovation projects, thereby elevating the quality of participant learning experiences and driving operational excellence
* Maintain a high degree of operational excellence directly correlates with participant satisfaction and successful learning outcomes.



**2\.Commercialisation, Revenue Scaling \& Innovation Leadership** 



* Support CEO and CPO Fort.Academy is actively prospecting, seeding, and nurturing opportunities for commercializing various knowledge products developed, standardized, and monetized under innovation programs.
* Support the CEO and CPO Fort.Academy, Fort.Academy to manage execution of initiatives or lead certain ones for scaling revenue generation from beneficiaries including industrial companies (corporates \& MSMEs), academia, industry professionals, and startups.
* Lead innovation skills training and competencies development programs, managing design, delivery, admissions, curriculum alignment, and operational aspects for future\-ready talent.
* Lead innovation projects and services, overseeing product innovations, structured processes, stakeholder management, trainee coaching, and outcome monitoring.



**3\.Participant Success \& Support** 



* Drive participant journeys from initial enrollment through career advancement, serving as the primary conduit for academic guidance while meticulously tracking progress against defined learning outcomes.
* Oversee comprehensive onboarding processes, infuse the human touch into addressing career goals, and nurture future\-ready talent in harmony with industrial digital transformation imperatives.innovation practicum got industrial innovation
* Act as a career advancement coach and innovation mentor for diverse trainees \- including students and professionals delivering personalized support on seamless program transitions, such as from GEC Level III to PGDTM, informed by individual performance and aspirations.
* Play a deeply personal role in guiding trainees through innovation lifecycles from challenge curation and solution exploration to product concept development and MUP design ensuring the tiered program structure empowers strategic missions with vital support.



**4\.Educational Infrastructure \& Resource Management** 



* Manage the  allocation, maintenance, and optimal utilization of all educational resources essential for the MTP and innovation programs.
* Ensure availability of lab equipment, software licenses for tools like CAD/CAM or PLC programming, classroom spaces, and inventory of consumables for uninterrupted hands\-on learning.
* Develop and manage necessary systems, processes, and tools to facilitate seamless knowledge sharing, program facilitation, and resource efficiency across physical, digital, and hybrid formats.
* Maintain all resources in prime working condition while working across Forge centers to support practice\-based, innovation\-centric learning models.



**5\.Team Staffing, Training \& Stakeholder Representation** 



* Staff, train, and manage a team of competent program leads and program associates apart from playing the role of the authorised representative of the company’s CEO to all external stakeholders in the respective program ecosystem.
* Foster internal and external stakeholder communication for streamlined project completion and ecosystem engagement.



**6\.Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Diligently collect, analyse, and report on a broad set of key performance indicators (KPIs) spanning program effectiveness, participant enrollment, completion rates, satisfaction scores, and innovation outcomes.
* Gather feedback on courses, faculty performance, and specific initiatives, consolidating data for the Program Director to fuel strategic decisions and continuous improvements.
* Monitor and report product innovation impacts, ensuring timely deployment of projects while demonstrating program value through meticulous metrics.



**7\.Program Operations, MarComm \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Lead/support the effective planning and implementation of events, conferences, visits, startup demos, ecosystem meetups, and other forms of physical, digital or hybrid events required towards creating a strong pipeline of talent and industry partners for the various innovation programs implemented by Fort.Academy
* Anchor the implementation of various activities and deliverables coming under the purview of Marketing Communications relating to outreach campaigns, event collateral, social media promotions etc.
